prompt: The camera moves steadily forward along a narrow, snow-covered path in the Mardi Himal Trail, Kaski, Nepal, under a night sky. The viewer's perspective glides smoothly over the uneven terrain, revealing scattered rocks and patches of snow illuminated by a faint, ambient light that casts soft shadows. As the camera advances, the surrounding trees stand tall and bare, their dark silhouettes stark against the dimly lit backdrop. Snowflakes gently fall from above, adding a serene yet cold atmosphere to the scene. The camera angle remains at eye level, providing an immersive first-person view of the trail. The environment is quiet and devoid of any human presence, emphasizing the solitude of the journey. The muted colors of the night—shades of deep blue and black—are occasionally broken by the white of the falling snow and the occasional glint of moonlight reflecting off the icy ground. The path winds slightly, leading the viewer deeper into the forest, where the darkness thickens and the trail becomes less defined, creating a sense of mystery and anticipation as the journey continues.
